text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding Sirocco-7B (upstream checkpoint -> our int4 conversion). Short prompts look fine but long-context summarization starts hallucinating ~1k tokens in. reproducible in local CI.

eli: oof. any tokenizer diffs or explicit rotary params in the model config?

maya: quick diff: token ids are 99% aligned, but sentinel token mapping differs (upstream: 50257, our tokenizer: 50256). also model config has `rotary_scale: 0.85` in the repo metadata, but our runtime defaults to 1.0. conversion script didn't pick up fractional rotary_scale. here's what I patched locally: 

```bash
# conversion snippet
python convert.py --in upstream.pt --out redwood.sirocco.int4 --rotary-scale 0.85 --sentinel-remap 50257:50256
```

eli: sentinel id mismatch would definitely perturb prefix caching + sentinel-aware prompts. nice catch.

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary (pre-fix):
- longctx-qa F1: baseline 0.72 -> sirocco-int4 0.59
- rouge-L: baseline 0.64 -> sirocco-int4 0.52
- hallucination-rate (in our nshot summarization set): +18%
(run id: sirocco-int4-prefix-2026-03-21)

anika: besides sentinel, did you inspect KV-cache ordering / head-dim permutation? past models had headwise layout differences that look like rotary-phase aliasing.

maya: good call. observed attention logit drift after kv cache reuse. snippet from attention diffs: 

```text
step 1024: attn_diag_mean upstream=0.023 our-converted=-0.018
step 1026: attn_diag_var upstream=0.0012 our-converted=0.0049
# suggests rotary multiplier offset / head ordering mismatch
```

sam: plan: try two controlled runs on dedicated pool — (A) apply sentinel remap + rotary_scale=0.85, (B) apply sentinel remap only. compare eval-bot metrics and token-level alignment. also try run with `--kv-headwise-swap` shim.

jorge: @maya can you open a conversion PR with flags `--rotary-scale`, `--sentinel-remap`, and a small autodetect that emits a WARNING when sentinel ids differ? include unit test that roundtrips 2 short examples.

maya: will open PR. kicking off canary A now on dedicated; ETA ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eval-bot: canary results (post-fix A: rotary_scale + sentinel remap):
- longctx-qa F1: 0.70 (+0.11 vs pre-fix)
- rouge-L: 0.62 (+0.10)
- hallucination-rate: +3% (much improved)
(run id: sirocco-int4-canary-A-2026-03-21)

eli: huge improvement. suggests rotary scaling was masking some attention alignment in long contexts.

anika: if A wins over B, let's make rotary scale mapping part of model metadata ingestion. add a safety test: run short and 1k-context eval during onboarding.

maya: PR posted: <https://git.redwood/sirocco/convert/pull/42> — includes tests and a `--autodetect-sentinel` flag. watching canary B now for comparison. :thumbsup:

sam: if B still lags, we'll schedule a quick follow-up to try `--kv-headwise-swap` and a head-dim permutation check in the runtime.

eval-bot: canary B (sentinel remap only): longctx-qa F1 0.61, rouge-L 0.54, hallucination-rate +12% (run id: sirocco-int4-canary-B-2026-03-21)

jorge: decision: merge PR + make rotary-scale read from model config by default. add onboarding warning when mismatch > 0.05.

maya: merging now, will patch runtime to read `rotary_scale` if present. thanks team.

eli: follow-up: add a short blurb to onboarding docs about common pitfalls: sentinel ids, rotary scale, headwise kv order. saves future triage time.

maya: adding docs + tests in same repo. closing loop. :white_check_mark:
